name: boundaries-bounds-esql
query: FROM boundaries | STATS envelope = ST_EXTENT_AGG(shape)

name: boundaries-centroid-esql
query: FROM boundaries | STATS centroid = ST_CENTROID_AGG(shape)

name: boundaries-bounds-centroid-esql
query: FROM boundaries | STATS envelope = ST_EXTENT_AGG(shape), centroid = ST_CENTROID_AGG(shape)

name: boundaries-intersects-count-esql
query: FROM boundaries | WHERE ST_INTERSECTS(shape, TO_GEOSHAPE("POLYGON((-0.1 49.0, 5.0 48.0, 15.0 49.0, 14.0 60.0, -0.1 61.0, -0.1 49.0))")) | STATS count = COUNT(*)

name: boundaries-contains-count-esql
query: FROM boundaries | WHERE ST_CONTAINS(shape, TO_GEOSHAPE("POLYGON((2.29 48.85, 2.31 48.85, 2.31 48.87, 2.29 48.87, 2.29 48.85))")) | STATS count = COUNT(*)

name: boundaries-within-count-esql
query: FROM boundaries | WHERE ST_WITHIN(shape, TO_GEOSHAPE("POLYGON((-0.1 49.0, 5.0 48.0, 15.0 49.0, 14.0 60.0, -0.1 61.0, -0.1 49.0))")) | STATS count = COUNT(*)

name: boundaries-disjoint-count-esql
query: FROM boundaries | WHERE ST_DISJOINT(shape, TO_GEOSHAPE("POLYGON((-0.1 49.0, 5.0 48.0, 15.0 49.0, 14.0 60.0, -0.1 61.0, -0.1 49.0))")) | STATS count = COUNT(*)

name: boundaries-envelope-esql
query: FROM boundaries | WHERE vertex_count >= 1000 AND vertex_count < 8000 | EVAL env = ST_ENVELOPE(shape) | STATS count = COUNT(*)

name: boundaries-simplify-esql
query: FROM boundaries | WHERE vertex_count >= 1000 AND vertex_count < 8000 | EVAL simplified = ST_SIMPLIFY(shape, 0.01) | STATS count = COUNT(*), avg_in = AVG(vertex_count), avg_out = AVG(ST_NPOINTS(simplified))

name: boundaries-simplify-preserve-esql
query: FROM boundaries | WHERE vertex_count >= 1000 AND vertex_count < 8000 | EVAL simplified = ST_SIMPLIFYPRESERVETOPOLOGY(shape, 0.01) | STATS count = COUNT(*), avg_out = AVG(ST_NPOINTS(simplified))

name: boundaries-buffer-esql
query: FROM boundaries | WHERE vertex_count >= 200 AND vertex_count < 800 | EVAL buffered = ST_BUFFER(shape, 0.001) | STATS count = COUNT(*), avg_out = AVG(ST_NPOINTS(buffered))

name: boundaries-geohash-grid-esql
query: FROM boundaries | WHERE ST_INTERSECTS(shape, TO_GEOSHAPE("BBOX(2.20, 2.40, 48.95, 48.75)")) | EVAL cell = ST_GEOHASH(shape, 5, TO_GEOSHAPE("BBOX(2.20, 2.40, 48.95, 48.75)")) | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY cell
